description: Gives a local web page its own origin: origin allocation and persistence, a durable store for what the page saves, and the preview report model. No dependencies.
Hosting for local-origin on ASP.NET Core: serving a scope's pages with a fixed security profile, the write channels and preview origins.
Line-level .NET profiler: patches IL after build and writes an HTML report of time and allocations per method and per source line.
